details:
With the advent of all of these colliders and physbones, it’s going to be easier than ever to be able to create avatars with all sorts of off-the-wall limbs and body elements controlled in increasingly creative ways. Better controlled tails and wings, extra arms, etc. But the only way to be able to grab a physbone or world object set up to be grabbed is with the Unity Humanoid’s hands. It would be nice to have a tail or wings be more prehensile or ways to dynamically move the arm grab points away from where Unity’s Humanoid dictates the hands can go.
So I propose a component that can be slapped onto just about anything that just duplicates what the hands already do to interact with physbones and grabbable world objects, except to the origin of the object it’s attached to. (I imagine this would mostly be used on empties.)
The “Is grabbing” something would be either triggered by a bool that can be activated on a animation, or directly from the Unity Humanoid’s hands doing a grab motion (and the desktop equivalent), with a option for the component to act as a “L_Hand” or “R_Hand”. Would make it impossible to have more than two grab points at any given time to not break compatibility with existing systems, but I think that’s a reasonable compromise.
title: [1181] Way to add 'hands' to any object
